integrity: Complete probabilistic argument and an independently defined exact finite-state verifier are supplied; computational tests do not substitute for the all-size proof.
limitations: Applies to finite simple trees, a single initial spreader, independent vertex-originated directed contacts, permanent informed status and contact-triggered stifling.
Path optimality requires a common stifling/transmission ratio.
Historical priority not independently certified: a local offspring factor occurs in earlier infinite-tree work and broader older reliability literature is not exhausted.
title: Seed-independent full dissemination and sharp path optimality in finite-tree stifling rumor networks
